note: Charts as a seed-declared manifest (item 2 refactor). `name` is the chart id; `tag` is the [a-z]+ control-character tag nu wraps every address in, hashed into SEED.lock; `behavior` selects the normalizer/classifier/segmenter, keyed by id in engine code. Adding a chart takes THREE things, stated accurately after the router-seam repair of 2026-08-04: (1) a row here; (2) if the behavior is new, a normalizer in engine/normalize.py:_NORMALIZERS, a classifier in _CLASSIFIERS and a segmenter in engine/extract.py:_SEGMENTERS — these are DICT LITERALS edited in place; there is NO registration API, and the earlier wording 'three registered functions — no dispatch edit' overstated it; (3) a row in seed/LANGUAGES.json saying which extension enters the chart. Before (3) existed, engine/router.py keyed Lean off a hardcoded `name.endswith('.lean')`, so a fully declared chart could still have nothing route to it; engine/chart_plugin_audit.py now checks routing as well as addressing. The `correspondence` chart (added 2026-08-04) carries the base category's morphisms as CLAIMS: a correspondence is proposed through the one inlet like any other claim, addressed exactly, and the correspondence SET is derived from accepted claims — never written directly. The `python` chart arrives from claude/repo-intake-adapter, rebased onto this HEAD on 2026-08-04: that branch's own CHARTS.json predated the conversation and correspondence charts and would have DELETED both, moving the SEED.lock tag hash; the rebase keeps all five and adds `py` as a sixth, so no existing tag moves.
